summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a docstring and a nested recursive helper add_to_cbd that applies CBD rule 1 (subject triples, recursing into unexpanded blank-node objects), then rule 3 (all triples of every statement whose rdf:subject is the node, no type or predicate/object matching). Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering the rule 1/2 counts (6, 2, 0), reified cases A (8) and B (13), incoming-reification exclusion, blank node in a reifier not expanded, a blank-node cycle terminating (4), and source immutability. Nothing was run: tests and scripts were not executed per instructions, and the expected counts were hand-computed against my own fixture. No commits made. Next step: run test/test_graph_cbd.py with the repository's test runner to confirm.
